items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: You see, you learn them old fellas. You can learn a whole lot from them.

ctx.x: My Blue Heaven and Trinidad Clover. Ask them can they play it. And that's a good number. That's a whole number. My Blue Heaven. You know when that number started? Right at the corner. And very instance, where they got a little boy in his car and my Blue Heaven. Yeah? Yeah. Kid Howard, yeah. Kid Howard the one, start the first playing that at the corner. When Howard was playing that, when Howard was playing that, when Howard was drunk, I'd go pick up Howard's horn and start playing for him. See Howard was, you…
You can learn a whole lot from them old fellas. Those old fellas, did they play a lot of waltzes too?
Yeah, yeah, they play a lot of them purely. That's the main band. A young band don't play nothing like that.
